assessment: The empty ScienceCard is incomplete rather than intrinsically ineligible. Lines 427-431 state that thin-shell SWCX surface brightness follows the inverse square of heliocentric distance and report that the value at 3.2 au is about 10 percent of that at 1 au. Those lines support a deterministic normalized predictor S(r)/S(1 au) = (r/1 au)^-2 with the source-reported numeric control values {1, 3.2} au, an exponent of -2, and a dimensionless brightness-ratio readout. A revised card can encode this relation without inventing data.

issues.detail: The card omits the source-closed thin-shell inverse-square relation S(r)/S(1 au) = (r/1 au)^-2 over r in {1, 3.2} au, directly supported at lines 427-431.
